title: AI-Powered Smart Survey Tool
description: Served as Team Lead for an AI-powered survey platform selected among the Top 25 finalists nationwide from over 5,000 ideas in Statathon 2025 (MoSPI). Built responsive frontend interfaces and integrated AI-powered backend services using REST APIs and FastAPI.
problemSolved: Traditional survey tools lack real-time insights and automated feedback analysis. MoSPI needed a way to intelligently process survey data with AI.
architecture: React frontend communicates with a Spring Boot API Gateway, routing requests to Python FastAPI microservices for AI processing, backed by PostgreSQL.
challenges: Integrating asynchronous AI Python services with synchronous Spring Boot workflows.
lessonsLearned: Gained deep understanding of microservice orchestration and API Gateway patterns.

title: Battery Vehicle Booking System
description: Developed a vehicle booking application with secure authentication, responsive UI, and RESTful backend integration.
problemSolved: Users needed a streamlined way to book electric vehicles without complex onboarding.
architecture: React SPA connected to a Node.js/Express backend using JWT for auth and MySQL for transactional data.
challenges: Handling concurrent booking requests to prevent double-booking of the same vehicle.
lessonsLearned: Implemented optimistic locking in database transactions.

title: Multi Cloud Usage Tracker
description: Cloud resource monitoring platform featuring dashboards, billing insights, cloud usage analytics, and scalable backend services.
problemSolved: Managing usage across AWS, GCP, and Azure from a single dashboard.
architecture: Spring Boot aggregates metrics from cloud provider SDKs and serves them via REST to a React dashboard.
challenges: Normalizing billing data structures across completely different cloud APIs.
lessonsLearned: Learned the Adapter design pattern to handle diverse external APIs gracefully.

title: E-Tutor Platform
description: Interactive online learning platform with modern UI, authentication, and course management features.
problemSolved: Connecting students with specialized tutors for one-on-one virtual sessions.
architecture: Monolithic Spring Boot application serving REST endpoints to a React frontend.
challenges: Designing an intuitive UI for scheduling across multiple time zones.
lessonsLearned: Mastered React state management for complex calendar components.

title: AI Driven Course Path Optimizer
description: AI-assisted recommendation platform that generates optimized learning paths based on user interests and goals.
problemSolved: Students often get overwhelmed by the sheer volume of available courses. This curates a specific path.
architecture: React frontend with a Python backend using scikit-learn for recommendation clustering.
challenges: Training the recommendation model on sparse user data.
lessonsLearned: Improved data pre-processing and collaborative filtering techniques.
